# pidginhost_dns_record (Resource)

A record in a FreeDNS zone; see pidginhost_dns_zone. The API gives records no id: a record is its name, type and the values its type uses, and changing any of them replaces the record. ttl changes in place. A and AAAA records use address, CNAME uses cname, MX uses preference and exchange, SRV uses priority, weight, port and target, TXT uses txtdata and CAA uses flag, tag and value. Host names in cname, exchange and target are compared without case and trailing dot. Destroying a record also succeeds if its zone has already been deactivated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_dns_zone" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
  ip     = "192.0.2.10"
}

resource "pidginhost_dns_record" "www" {
  zone    = pidginhost_dns_zone.example.domain
  name    = "www"
  type    = "A"
  ttl     = 3600
  address = "192.0.2.10"
}

resource "pidginhost_dns_record" "mail" {
  zone       = pidginhost_dns_zone.example.domain
  name       = "@"
  type       = "MX"
  preference = 10
  exchange   = "mail.example.com"
}

resource "pidginhost_dns_record" "spf" {
  zone    = pidginhost_dns_zone.example.domain
  name    = "@"
  type    = "TXT"
  txtdata = "v=spf1 mx -all"
}

resource "pidginhost_dns_record" "caa" {
  zone  = pidginhost_dns_zone.example.domain
  name  = "@"
  type  = "CAA"
  flag  = 0
  tag   = "issue"
  value = "letsencrypt.org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Record name: @ or an empty string for the zone apex, a name relative to the zone such as www, or a fully qualified name such as www.example.com. Internationalized names are converted to their ASCII form.
- `type` (String) Record type: A, AAAA, CAA, CNAME, MX, SRV or TXT.
- `zone` (String) Domain name of the zone, such as example.com.

### Optional

- `address` (String) IPv4 address of an A record, or IPv6 address of an AAAA record.
- `cname` (String) Target host name of a CNAME record.
- `exchange` (String) Mail server host name of an MX record.
- `flag` (Number) Flag of a CAA record: 0, or 128 for critical.
- `port` (Number) Port of an SRV record.
- `preference` (Number) Preference of an MX record.
- `priority` (Number) Priority of an SRV record.
- `source` (String) internal for a domain registered with PidginHost, external for a domain added to the account in the PidginHost panel. Defaults to internal. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `tag` (String) Tag of a CAA record, such as issue, issuewild or iodef.
- `target` (String) Target host name of an SRV record.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live in seconds, from 1 to 2147483647. Defaults to 14400.
- `txtdata` (String) Text of a TXT record, without quotes.
- `value` (String) Value of a CAA record, such as letsencrypt.org.
- `weight` (Number) Weight of an SRV record.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <zone>/<source>/<fully qualified name>/<type>/<hash of the values>. It changes whenever the record is replaced.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a record by "<zone>/<source>/<name>/<type>", when the zone has one
# record of that name and type. Write the name as the configuration does.
terraform import pidginhost_dns_record.www example.com/internal/www/A

# Otherwise add the record's values in zone file order, separated by spaces.
terraform import pidginhost_dns_record.mail "example.com/internal/@/MX/10 mail.example.com"
```
